title: Stocks, Treasuries Get Relief Ahead of CPI, US Diesel Passes $6/Gallon
description:
US equity futures and Treasuries find some relief as investors await the latest inflation data for a signal on whether the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next week. US diesel prices rose above $6 a gallon for the first time ever, raising the risk of further energy-driven inflation. The US marks 25 years since the September 11 terrorist attacks. Isabelle Mateos Y Lago of BNP Paribas joins "Bloomberg Brief" to look ahead to the CPI data.
